title: Kyber release 0.29
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Kyber 0.29 make am easy to set up real time control, e dey show tins clear well well, and e don ready for plenty more kain environment.
html:
Kyber 0.29: e dey reach far pass, picture sharp pass, control strong pass

Kyber 0.29 don make am easy to set up real-time control, e dey show tins clear well-well, and e don ready for plenty oda environments. Native WebSocket support dey carry Kyber enter company networks wey before no dey gree am, 4:4:4 encoding dey keep every small detail for di screen native resolution, and new embedded capture features don open road for Raspberry Pi and edge deployments. E still lay di first foundation wey go help teams manage plenty Kyber machines togeda at once.

Dis na wetin e mean for real life.

E dey reach far pass: Kyber don dey work for networks wey before dey block am

Wen di network say no

Normally, Kyber dey connect through QUIC, one modern network protocol wey dem build for speed. Na one of di reasons why Kyber dey feel sharp-sharp like say di machine dey right in front of you. Di only wahala be say some company networks dey block QUIC, or dem no just dey allow am. For operator wey wan reach machine behind strict firewall, dat one mean say connection no go enter at all.

Kyber don find anoda road with WebSocket

Kyber 0.29 don add full backup route through WebSocket, one standard wey almost every network dey accept. If dem block QUIC, Kyber go switch go WebSocket and di connection go enter. E fit slow small, but you go still dey connected. Your control line go still dey open, no mata wetin IT policy talk.

WebSocket support don dey native inside Kyber desktop client now. For inside di system, di browser version and di desktop version dey share di same connection code, so any improvement wey land go reach both of dem at once.

Picture sharp pass: every pixel, every colour, for any machine

Why remote screens dey usually look blur

To save bandwidth, most video streaming dey store colour for lower resolution pass brightness. For movie, nobody go notice. But for work screen, everybody go see am: small-small spreadsheet cells go hard to read, brand colours go dey shift, and thin lines for 3D models go dey bleed enter each oda.

Full 4:4:4 colour for your native resolution

Kyber 0.29 dey encode for full 4:4:4 colour, wey mean say every pixel go keep im exact colour. Text go dey crisp, interfaces go dey sharp, and colours go dey accurate, even for machines wey dia graphics hardware no fit encode 4:4:4 by imsef.

Kyber don also stop to dey shrink big screens. Before now, software encoding dey reduce anytin wey wide pass 1920 pixels go Full HD. Dat limit don comot. 4K desktop now dey stream for 4K.

Your Excel go dey readable, anywhere wey e dey run.

More platforms: real-time control, even for Raspberry Pi

Kyber server fit capture images now through GStreamer, di main toolkit wey plenty embedded devices dey use for audio and video. Dis release still bring smarter hardware selection, better frame handling, and faster encoding, plus fix for one crash wey dey happen for Intel Arc graphics cards.

Togeda, all dis changes dey allow us tune Kyber well-well for Raspberry Pi and oda small, low-power devices. Dis one mata well-well for robotics, drones, and every edge device wey Kyber low-latency streaming need to run on modest hardware. Special Raspberry Pi package dey come soon for GitLab.

Control strong pass: di foundation to manage plenty Kyber machines at once

Management portal dey come, wey go allow teams see and control every Kyber machine from one place. Kyber 0.29 don lay di foundation.

Heartbeat for every machine

One new agent dey allow every Kyber host send small signal every 10 seconds or so to tok say e dey online and ready. If di signal stop, you go know say di machine no dey available. No need to dey guess, no need to dey check am by hand.

Sessions wey go stay signed in

Connections wey don pass authentication now dey get automatic token exchange and renewal. Token be like temporary digital pass. Kyber dey renew am for background now, so secure sessions go stay open without say users go dey sign in again and again.

One-click access with kyber:// links

Kyber don get im own link format now. Click kyber:// link for browser, for email, or for dashboard, and di desktop client go open straight for di correct machine.

E don easy to set up for macOS

Kyber server for macOS now dey come as complete package. E simple to install and e simple to distribute across plenty Macs. Wetin dey come next: one signed package wey dey work fully, wey macOS go trust straight away.

Oda improvements and fixes

  • Audio: di Opus audio codec don move go version 1.6.1.
  • Security: OIDC, di standard wey dey behind single sign-on, now dey support optional audience validation. Kyber fit check say na for Kyber dem issue login token, no be for anoda app.
  • Certificates: Kyber now dey check secure connections against di list of trusted certificates wey your operating system get.
  • Web client: pointer lock now dey work well for games wey dey hide di cursor.
  • VLC: di Video buffer feature now dey work with VideoToolbox, Apple hardware video decoder.
  • Reliability: e dey comot clean wen no display dey, session dey close quick pass before, fix for GCC 16 build, and logs wey no dey make noise like before.

Collect Kyber 0.29

Kyber 0.29 don land now. Everytin wey you need to take start dey here.
